Recall Product: MultiFit Wild Bird Mix 2,5 kg 04.11.2022
Dear Customers,
in the course of transparent and open communication and our focus on the best possible health of
humans and animals, we inform about a current recall.
We are recalling the following item due to exceeding the maximum content of ragweed seeds:
MultiFit Wild Bird Mix 2,5 kg (Article No.: 1081049)
This concerns all items with the following best before date / batch:
BBD: 30.06.2024
Batch: L332022
Ragweed seeds do not pose a risk to animals. When the feed is scattered on the ground, the seeds can
germinate and give rise to a ragweed plant whose pollen can trigger allergic reactions in humans. In the
interests of preventive consumer protection, we have immediately withdrawn the affected articles from
sale.
You can of course return the above mentioned item to one of our stores. The purchase price will be
refunded to you.
We regret the incident and apologize for any inconvenience.
